scope: Source inspection and pinned dependency declarations. This is not a completed store questionnaire, release-binary network audit, or legal approval.

local_detector_update_20261110.component: Pinned CLD2 with local model tables, compiled into both clients
local_detector_update_20261110.processing: Language identification runs on device without a provider request or model download. Protected technical literals are masked in the classification copy; the original message is preserved.
local_detector_update_20261110.telemetry: No network or telemetry code in the two CLD2 bridges or MessageLanguage adapters. This does not describe other installed SDKs.
local_detector_update_20261110.limits: A classifier reliability flag is not a semantic translation confidence score. Classification can be wrong or abstain.
local_detector_update_20261110.other_sdks: Google ML Kit translation SDKs remain linked for explicit full translation. Their operational-data declarations below remain relevant. No claim that all SDK operational traffic was removed.
local_detector_update_20261110.qualification: Both native debug/simulator integrations qualified. Existing signed Android and unsigned Apple release artifacts predate this change; final release inspection remains required.

flows.required_for: Account-based chat; the introductory local preview does not establish that every account field is optional.
flows.retention: Vipi profile until account deletion; WorkOS deletion is retried separately. Provider authentication/security retention must be reconciled with the actual production configuration.

recipients: intended conversation peers receive public messaging keys
flows.retention: Managed with the account/device lifecycle; key-claim receipts have separate expiry. Private Signal keys remain on device.

recipients: Fallible Software, Co. relay on Hetzner
flows.retention: Ciphertext is cleared on receipt, cancellation or expiry cleanup. Delivery window is 72 hours from message creation; metadata expires seven days after the window. Cleanup outages can delay deletion.
flows.google_content_boundary: Apply Google's E2EE exclusion only to content unreadable by every intermediary. It does not exclude readable routing/timing metadata or separately reported messages.

data: account-local word/phrase exposure-day counters and keyed identifiers
flows.collection_candidate: Local content is outside store collection definitions while it stays on device. SDK operational data and model downloads are separate flows below.
open: Complete final release-device network observations, including installed system voices; source review is not proof of every third-party runtime behavior.

familiarity_record.purpose: Adjust target-language dwell time from completed visible displays; no claim of attention or mastery.
familiarity_record.storage: Encrypted per-account MessageVault records; HMAC-SHA256 identifiers with an independent random per-account 32-byte key. No message text or message identifiers in these records.
familiarity_record.network: No upload path in the two inspected familiarity stores.
familiarity_record.retention: Stored with the local account vault; not part of the explicit human-message history export.
familiarity_record.qualification: Android persistence and account/pair isolation qualified; Apple encrypted persistence remains unqualified while signing/keychain hold is unchanged.

flows.retention: Provider controlled; no app-defined expiry or zero-retention guarantee established.
flows.apple_linkage: Pinned ML Kit manifests declare their SDK data unlinked and not used for tracking. App account/device identifiers are separately linked; final console aggregation must preserve these distinct purposes.
open: Map exact Android dependency versions and final release configuration to current SDK disclosures.
Confirm manifests are included in the actual signed Apple archive. Simulator excludes the ML Kit binary adapters.
Do not equate disabled Firebase Analytics with absence of ML Kit operational analytics.

flows.retention: Encrypted token held by Vipi while registered; removed through device/account lifecycle. Provider retention is separate.
open: Published notice read back November 11. Reconcile per-installation SDK retention separately from Vipi account-token deletion and qualify actual final delivery behavior.
No real production APNs/FCM delivery qualification yet. Analytics flags alone do not prove absence of all SDK identifiers.
flows.registration_choice: Android data-only background delivery registers when account is ready, independent of visible alert permission. iOS registration follows permission and the Vipi notification setting.
flows.native_sdk_lifecycle: Android account deletion cancels app work/alerts and deletes server token/outbox. Current native code does not call Firebase token/installation deletion or disable auto-init; per-installation SDK state may persist. Workers without authentication cannot drain chat or register account tokens.

flows.retention: Entitlement records until account deletion; duplicate-notification receipts expire after 30 days. Store payment records follow provider requirements.
flows.excluded_claim: Vipi does not receive payment card details through the implemented store verification path. Do not infer that it receives no purchase data.
open: Actual production products, sandbox transactions and store notifications remain unqualified.

flows.retention: Vipi keeps usage/request records, not normal prompt/reply text. API-provider retention and processing terms require account-specific verification; do not mark the entire flow ephemeral based only on Vipi's transient text handling.
open: Verify the existing company API account's applicable processing terms before customer activation. DeepSeek's general February 2026 privacy policy expressly excludes downstream apps from its scope.
Evaluate Google sharing exceptions from actual contract/consent, not from the provider's name or TLS.

data: selected original message or vBot reply
recipients: Fallible Software, Co. authorized reviewers on Hetzner
flows.retention: Reports expire after 30 days or relevant account deletion. Other block/restriction records have account-lifecycle retention. Server encryption is readable by authorized reviewers and is not human-chat E2EE.

data: user-directed password-encrypted completed human-message history export
recipients: user-selected storage provider for history export
Fallible Software, Co. private disaster-recovery storage
flows.retention: User manages exported files and password. Service retains up to three verified generations, excluding relayed messages, public messaging-key records, push tokens and report text. Earlier metadata copies can outlive account deletion until replaced/deleted.
flows.classification: Account for collected metadata in its original categories. Do not describe all backups as uncollected merely because encrypted; Vipi can decrypt its own service backups. User export is a distinct, explicit action.
open: Final native export provider interaction must match the submitted binary.
Restored services must reconcile later deletions and restrictions before reopening; this final disaster-recovery gate is not yet qualified.

data: request IP used for ingress throttling
recipients: independent authentication/provider systems for their requests
flows.retention: Service access logs are disabled in source configuration; critical error logging remains. Rate windows are cleaned after roughly two hours. No IP-derived location feature is implemented.
flows.classification: Hashing does not by itself anonymize a rate key. Determine category and linkage from actual use; do not declare precise/coarse location merely because the network receives an IP address.
open: Reconcile final deployed infrastructure log fields/retention and production WorkOS auth metadata without reading customer content.
